features.text: Knee orthosis (KO), single upright, thigh and calf, with adjustable flexion and extension joint, medial-lateral and rotation control, prefabricated, off-the-shelf

indications: Early or mild unicompartmental osteoarthritis of the knee
measurement: Measure with leg straight. Calf: 6 in. below center of kneecap. Thigh: 6 in. above center of kneecap. If between sizes, Comfort sizes bridge the gap for larger thighs. Two measurements required: calf circumference (6 in. below mid-patella) and thigh circumference (6 in. above mid-patella), both with leg in extension. Comfort sizes accommodate proportionally larger thighs (same calf range as standard, wider thigh range). Select laterality based on compartment affected: Medial OA (inner knee pain) = Right Medial / Left Lateral model. Lateral OA (outer knee pain) = Right Lateral / Left Medial model.
